member.name: T:FinanceSentry.Modules.Radar.Application.Services.HoldingsBasedReturnCalculator
member.summary: A holdings-based price return for the book over a window of captures (finance-framework R1(b)). Same method as the Risk module's BookDrawdownCalculator: each step between two captures revalues the quantities held at the EARLIER capture at the LATER capture's prices, the ratio of that to the earlier value is the step's return, and the step returns chain into one growth index. A deposit, or a purchase made from idle cash, adds a position the earlier capture did not hold, so it contributes nothing to the step that bought it. A position sold between captures is carried at its earlier value for that step (its exit price is not in a capture) and contributes nothing after. It is a price return: dividends paid to cash are outside it, so compare it with SPY's price return. Pure: no I/O, no clock.

member.name: T:FinanceSentry.Modules.Radar.Domain.PeriodTwr
member.summary:
Single-period book-vs-SPY scoreboard row. BookTwr is M3, the time-weighted return of the brokerage sleeve (IBKR + Inzhur, idle broker cash included, so a purchase from cash is not a gain), chained daily over the snapshot closes with each deposit and withdrawal the brokers report taken out (finance-framework §3.4), and with the day a provider was linked bridged as capital, not return. SpyTwr is SPY's adjusted-close return over the identical window (BookTwrFrom to BookTwrTo, M9), so Delta is a like-for-like excess return. With no measurable book window, SpyTwr runs from the first bar on or after Since and there is no Delta.
